summary: Validation actually performed centers on internal consistency, registered prediction discipline, and one external observation point — not statistical validation against independent data. VERIFIED-in-repo: (1) a claims linter (scripts/lint_claims.py + docs/claims.yaml) that I executed — exit 0, 0 hits across 10 deliverables — which structurally blocks refuted/retired wordings (POOL-refuted placement attribution, "37/37 checks", "held exactly" 0.192, the naked 1.52x calibration point); (2) determinism (bit-for-bit seed-42 re-run; per-seed populations byte-identical across arms, hash-checked by verify_2026_runs.py) over a 9-seed A/B/C matrix archived in docs/runs/; (3) the R3 byte-identity regression: an E0-null degenerate decision-layer run must reproduce the archived arm run byte-for-byte on shared columns (verify_E_runs.py --null), archived three times and re-proved before each Scenario-E matrix; (4) pre-registered directional predictions with scored MISSES kept as misses (Phase D: P-3c, P-3d wrong — surplus beats optimal placement and dissolves the equity gap; Phase E: P-E1 magnitude miss with an appended alphaHazard arithmetic correction; Scenario E: P-SE1 band miss, P-SE10 draw-dependent reversal); (5) negative controls: asthma/chronic-physical null enforced per-run and pooled, Wachinger non-departure check, registered-inert triage arms, closure-free control arms, and the CR/CP POOL control that reproduced C's headcount exactly (attribution demoted to dispersion). External calibration is exactly ONE contemporaneous occupancy observation (Street Roots 2020-09-16, ~90+~40 of 198 beds); the model fills 198/198 (OCC ~1.1x right-censored, Charles Jordan ~2.5x); deliverables must use the censored bracket 1.5–15.6x (15.6x = unconstrained demand 2,022), enforced by a linter regex that fails any 1.52x-over-predict sentence lacking "15.6" on the same line; the required framing is "improves outcomes under the modelled assumptions", never "recreates what happened". The EPA-AQS ratio-1.0000 check validates exposure arithmetic, not behavior. One-dimensional sensitivity exists and is archived: bed sweep BS080–BS160 (7 levels x 3 seeds; knife-edge: +5% beds matches C, +10% erases the equity gap), window arms W24/W72 x A/B/C x 3 seeds, three closure draws (sign of the refusal-redistribution effect flips by draw), and two smoke series (1.75x and Canberra 4.436x). NOT done, candidly per the repo's own documents: out-of-sample temporal validation (one observation, one event), spatial cross-validation of the optimizer (fitted and evaluated on the same 6,842 coordinates — "no hold-out, no resampling"), smoke-field LOOCV (unexecutable with 2 monitors), joint/global uncertainty propagation (all sweeps one-factor), local estimation of behavioral coefficients (E9 occupancy fit deferred; alphaHazard set by registered arithmetic and scored a MISS), presence-fraction sweep, node-site-tolerance sweep (falsely claimed once, now linter-refuted), and any second-event or second-city transfer. Open publication-relevant defects: V25 resting ventilation 0.61 m3/h absent from its EPA source (touches every dose figure and the 2.7x ratio; author decision pending), A-04 blocking (99-bed unit unconfirmed), A-16 unmet, U-12 recalibration pending, D15 residuals (V33 caretaker provenance), graph-census prose now mostly corrected to 3/22 but with one muddled mixed-vintage row, TR's internal test_routing contradiction, and user-owned camera-ready items.

items.name: Determinism / seed stability
items.detail: Re-run at seed 42 bit-for-bit identical; heterogeneity-layer baseline invariance byte-identical on 25 shared columns. 9-seed (42-50) A/B/C matrix with per-run seed-robustness table; verify_2026_runs.py hash-asserts per-seed population byte-identity across arms and identical unreachable id sets (U-27 invariant). Run archives exist in docs/runs/present-day-three-arm (A/B/C x seeds 42-50).

items.name: R3 byte-identity regression
items.detail: E0-null configuration (decision layer ON, every mechanism degenerate: aware=1, L0, latch, sigma=0, barriers=0, pets admitted) must reproduce the archived arm run byte-identically over all shared agents.csv/shelters.csv columns. E0null-A/B/C-seed42 archived under docs/runs/phase-e/, scenario-e/, and scenario-e-v2/; 'R3 re-proved at this commit before the matrix' for v2 (commit 257017d).

items.name: Registered predictions with scored misses — Phase D
items.detail: Registered 2026-07-28 20:49 before launch (one smoke-test run disclosed as OBSERVED). Outcomes: P-1a/b/c/d/e/g, P-2a/b, P-3a/b HIT; P-1f PARTIAL MISS (8/54 runs travel median >2%, max +3.2%); P-3c MISS (B crosses C's access at 1.2x, not 1.4-1.6x); P-3d MISS (mobility gap vanishes at any surplus). Misses reported as the disconfirming-results section and reframed the headline.

items.name: Registered predictions with scored misses — Phase E / Scenario E
items.detail: P-E1 MISS on magnitude (predicted 10-15% sheltered; observed 17.8% post-pet-correction) with alphaHazard=-8.0 arithmetic error appended as CORRECTION, never edited; P-E4 confirmed via its pre-registered disconfirmation clause (arm D inert, 0 capacity refusals). Scenario E v1: P-SE1 MISS on attempt band (0.52 vs registered 0.55-0.75); P-SE3/P-SE5 NOT EVALUABLE (zero blockage events — emptiness reported as the finding). v2: P-SE10 MISS as registered (refusal-redistribution sign reverses for draw r1); P-SE7/8/9/11 confirmed. pushThetaThreshold executed as 0.0 not -0.25 (Repast negative-number parser bug) — caught by pre-push audit, impact none (parameter never consulted).

items.name: Negative controls
items.detail: (a) U-19 asthma + chronic_physical access-rate null: per-run 3-SE and pooled 9-seed 2-SE tests in the invariant gate; (b) regression asthma null in every arm; (c) verify_E checks: asthma speed/dose null (0.02 m/s, 3 SE), Wachinger high-barrier non-departure, UNAWARE immobility; (d) registered-inert arms P-SE4/ER-D (zero capacity refusals stated in advance); (e) closure-free control arms SEnc/SE2nc archived for smoke-vs-obstacle separation.

items.name: Attribution control (CR random sites / CP POOL)
items.detail: Ten random sites from the same 498-node candidate pool reproduce C's sheltered count run-for-run (6,570/6,565/6,566; post-U-27 'POOL null now exact'), refuting the optimized-placement attribution for headcount; siting credit survives only on walking distance. 18 control runs archived (CR2026r1-3, CP2026r4-6 x seeds 42-44).

items.name: External calibration against observation
items.detail: Exactly ONE behavioral observation point: Street Roots, night of 2020-09-15 (published 09-16) — ~90 occupants Oregon Convention Center + ~40 Charles Jordan ≈ 130 of 198 beds, a single newsroom count. Historical-reference run (n=2,037, 2x99 beds) fills 198/198 at both sites; per-site OCC ~1.1x (right-censored), CJ ~2.5x; unconstrained demand 2,022 gives the 15.6x upper edge. Direction attributed to A-12 universal awareness vs local survey (65% never heard of the shelters). U-12 recalibration still pending.
items.status: VERIFIED (documents); the observation itself is a REPORTED newsroom figure

items.name: Calibration bracket + enforced wording
items.detail: Deliverables must state the D7-censored bracket 1.5-15.6x with 1.52x as 'the uncensored lower edge'. claims.yaml entry calibration-1-52-overpredict (status corrected-pending) uses a regex that flags any 1.52/over-predict pairing UNLESS '15.6' appears within 100 same-line characters, so the sanctioned bracket sentence passes and the naked point claim fails. Fixed framing wording: 'improves outcomes under the modelled assumptions', never 'recreates what actually happened'.

items.name: Exposure-engine arithmetic check vs EPA AQS
items.detail: Sigma C·dt recomputed in Python from the raw AQS CSV independently of the model: 54,002.7 vs model 54,002.8 ug·m-3·h, ratio 1.0000. This validates the integration arithmetic against the model's own input series — it is not calibration against independent exposure observations.

items.name: Independent route-length validation (test_routing.py)
items.detail: Python Dijkstra reimplementation, tests T1-T5. TR's verification table now candidly states it 'Fails on current output by design' (V11 network_dist_to_shelter_m stale for retargeted agents since fix D-6). However TR:824-827 still says it 'reproduces the Java distances exactly... All pass' without a vintage label — an unresolved internal contradiction within TECHNICAL_REFERENCE.md.

items.name: Independent reimplementation (websim TypeScript port)
items.detail: Tier 0-4 fidelity ladder: RNG bit-parity (2.63M draws + 100M depth tier), initial-world identity (3,539,712 distances bit-equal; snap_gap_m tolerance-equal at 1e-8 m on 6,390/6,842 rows), own-engine R3 null, statistical cross-validation vs archive (unreachable id set identical, marginals equal), Tier-4 structural identity 6,546/6,842 rows byte-identical, final_state 114-row divergence at permutation p=0.776. Cross-engine byte-identity on Chromium/Firefox/WebKit/Node.
items.status: REPORTED (test suite in websim/ not executed by this audit)

items.name: Invariant gates (pass counts)
items.detail: verify_2026_runs.py: manifest seed/scenario/numAgents, clean-tree flag, data_version_tag identity, source-integrity checksum identity, U-03 bed sums, U-19 controls, U-27 id-set identity, plus 55 extended-family runs (histref, D, CR, CP, BS, W). verify_E_runs.py: 99/99 ER checks; 387/387 (--se, v1); 546/546 (v2). 54-run U-27 re-run matrix exit 0 at deddfca.

items.name: Sensitivity: bed-equivalence sweep BS080-BS160
items.detail: One-dimensional capacity sweep at B's 36 real sites, s in {0.8,1.0,1.05,1.10,1.15,1.2,1.4,1.6} x demand, seeds 42-44 (21 archived runs + B itself). Result: 73.3% -> 91.5% -> 96.0-96.1% (=C at 1.05x, so C's siting is worth at most ~342 beds) -> 99.5% plateau from 1.10x; mobility gap 28.3 -> 23.5 -> 14.9 -> -0.0 pp from 1.10x.
items.source: docs/runs/phaseD-bed-sweep (dir listing: BS080/105/110/115/120/140/160 x 3 seeds); docs/final/TECHNICAL_REFERENCE.md:2185-2205; scripts/verify_2026_runs.py:187-192

items.name: Sensitivity: window arms W24/W72
items.detail: From-start observation windows 24/72/312 h x arms A/B/C x seeds 42-44 (18 archived runs). B/C mean-dose ratio 1.29 -> 1.33 -> 1.98; walking's share of C's dose benefit 100% -> 83% -> 4.5%. Episode-aligned (hour-79) window arm deliberately NOT run (needs SIM_START code change; descoped on record).

items.name: Sensitivity: closure draws and smoke series
items.detail: Scenario-E v2 runs E18 across three committed closure draws r1-r3 (A-34 range protocol); the refusal-redistribution sign flips by draw (P-SE10 miss), demonstrating why single-schedule designs mislead. Two smoke severities run: v1 baked 1.75x transform, v2 Canberra-anchored 4.436x (peak 2,496.1). The registered smokeScale sweep (0.857/1.143) did NOT run — superlinearity clause explicitly untested.

items.name: Sensitivity: ventilation-rate sweep
items.detail: Registry sweep 0.4-0.8 m3/h on the resting rate is recorded as done ('sensitivity-swept'), but D16 shows it fails to bracket the EPA table's own candidate cells (Light 0.72-0.78; Sedentary 0.25-0.30) — the sweep excludes the sedentary range entirely.
items.status: REPORTED, with a VERIFIED documented inadequacy

items.name: Out-of-sample temporal validation
items.detail: Does not exist. The only behavioral observation is the single 2020-09-16 occupancy record; no second event, no held-out time period, no occupancy time series. The repo states the record is 'a single newsroom observation on one night'.

items.name: Spatial cross-validation / optimizer hold-out
items.detail: Does not exist, by the repo's own adversarial review: the optimizer is fitted and evaluated on the same B2026-n6842-seed42/agents.csv coordinates — 'no hold-out, no resampling of campsite locations, no spatial cross-validation'; C's 96.0% vs B's 91.6% is an in-sample upper bound. Disclosed as the chapter's first limitation (tex:861).

items.name: Smoke-field leave-one-out cross-validation
items.detail: Specified as the decision test for uniform-vs-IDW (DESIGN_SPEC V5) but never executed; SMOKE_FIELD_AUDIT states LOOCV with 2 in-county stations leaves one — 'a test with essentially no power. The specified decision test is therefore not executable as written, which is itself the finding.' A-01 spatially-uniform field remains an active assumption.

items.name: Global / joint parameter uncertainty propagation
items.detail: No joint or global sensitivity/uncertainty analysis exists anywhere in docs/runs/ or the reports; every executed sweep varies one factor (beds, window, smoke series, closure draw). The science tier proposes 'a one-at-a-time or fractional-factorial' design as future work only. No Monte Carlo propagation of parameter uncertainty through model outputs was found.

items.name: Local estimation of behavioral coefficients
items.detail: Not done. Phase-E behavioral parameters (V35-V43) are pre-registered literature midpoints; alphaHazard=-8.0 was 'calibration-by-arithmetic', registered, and scored a MISS (realized attempt share 0.502 vs targeted 0.385; corrected value ~-8.7 noted, not adopted). The E9 occupancy calibration that would fit it to the historical record is explicitly deferred and no E9 run archive exists.

items.name: Second-event / second-city transfer
items.detail: No transfer test of any kind: one county (Multnomah), one event (Sept 2020 smoke), one street network. Nothing in docs/runs/, the chapter, or the critique responses claims or attempts generalization to another city or episode; Scenario-E severities are counterfactual transforms of the same event (A-33).

items.name: Presence-fraction sweep (U-14)
items.detail: The 2025 PIT administrative-augmentation caveat is carried verbatim in deliverables but never operationalized: 'no presence-fraction sweep exists anywhere, and verify_2026_runs.py hard-asserts n==6842'. Also the 2,419 street-verified figure was not verifiable in-repo.

items.name: Node-site tolerance sensitivity (falsely claimed, now blocked)
items.detail: The presentation once claimed a 'registered sensitivity test' of NODE_SITE_TOLERANCE_M=100 that was never executed (hard-coded static final, identical in all 101 manifests). Registered as refuted in claims.yaml; the linter blocks the phrasing. The test itself remains not run. Also deferred: TYPE-1200/A11 street-class sensitivity (Ross Island Bridge coding).

items.name: Other deferred arms on record
items.detail: Episode-aligned window arm (SIM_START code change), D3 equity-objective placement, D5 information ablation, arm-B baseline-real, +AWARE/+INFO(L2)/+RIDES/+BARRIER intervention arms, 9-seed E extension, L3 word-of-mouth, U-17 exit-option sensitivity (g in {0,0.1,0.25}) — all listed as deferred/descoped, none run.

items.name: OPEN DEFECT: V25 resting ventilation rate
items.detail: 0.61 m3/h 'resting' rate does NOT appear in the cited EPA EFH 2011 Ch.6 Table 6-2 (Light 0.72-0.78, Sedentary 0.25-0.30 straddle it); walking 1.62 is confirmed but is one age cell (31-<41), not an adult aggregate (adult-weighted ~1.59). Blast radius: every cumulative_dose_ug column in every archived run, the published 2.7x ratio (5 deliverable locations), V50's rationale, and websim golden checks keyed on 0.6100. Qualitative finding survives (any candidate cell keeps IR_walk > IR_rest); absolute doses and the ratio do not (2.25x-5.40x depending on cell). Author decision required; explicitly not fixed as of 2026-08-04.

items.name: Graph-census prose status
items.detail: The headline stale figures are now corrected in the current tree: TR's fix table reads 3 reattached / 22 split and variables.csv V-REATTACH reads '3 of 25 corrections'. Pre-U-27 4/23 figures survive only vintage-labeled (STREET_NETWORK_VALIDATION.md:11 'pre-U-27 unfiltered graph (27 corrupt IDs -> 4 reattached / 23 split') and in the archived final-baseline manifest. Residual muddle: TR:808 labels 171/59,725 components as post-U-27 manifest values while TR:814's table row says 'measured pre-U-27, not re-measured on the freeway-filtered graph' — the two sentences cannot both be right as written.
items.status: VERIFIED (mostly corrected; one residual internal inconsistency)

items.name: OPEN QUESTION: Pathways pooled-vs-unsheltered demographics (D15)
items.detail: Age bands and chronic-condition prevalence are the POOLED Table 2.1 sample (N=541), not the unsheltered-only Table 6.1 (N=192): 65+ 5.0% vs 2.6%, chronic 39.1% vs 31.1% — not inert, since age drives walking speed. Documented as a deliberate, author-confirmed choice with defense (stability, source's own framing); deliverables must say 'pooled sample'. Residual open items: V33's '0.022 caretaker rate' provenance does not match the source as stated, and V22's gloss overstates a self-identified disability question.
items.status: VERIFIED (choice disclosed; two residual discrepancies open)

items.name: OPEN DEFECT: A-04 unconfirmed 2020 shelter capacity
items.detail: The 99-per-site nightly capacity is newsroom-sourced, never confirmed by a primary agency document, and the unit (cots/positions/persons) is unstated; classified BLOCKING in the registry and 'the single largest driver of the headline result' since sheltered==capacity exactly in every historical-reference run. Sensitivity plan (confirm + sweep) not executed.

items.name: OPEN DEFECT: A-16 order-dependent admission
items.detail: Order-independent two-phase admission was specified as prerequisite for any n>beds run and never implemented; the last bed is awarded by the per-tick RNG shuffle. Approved wording downgrades scarce-capacity subgroup magnitudes to 'indicative'; FDVR notes it becomes MORE material once capacity binds hard.

items.name: OPEN: U-12 recalibration + U-01 marginal re-derivation
items.detail: The calibration claim is registry-status 'corrected-pending' — final point value awaits the U-12 population recalibration, which was descoped in round 5. U-01: the published 0.192 mobility marginal is analytically unreachable (coded expectation 0.2033; pooled 9-seed 0.2038); the 'held exactly' phrasing is linter-refuted and gone, but whether the sampler constants were re-derived and runs repeated is not evidenced anywhere I read.

items.name: Open user-owned camera-ready items
items.detail: NSF award number, affiliation confirmation (normalized text is email-domain-consistent, 'not a verified fact'), Zenodo DOI / repo visibility — flagged in SUBMIT.md section 0 and the round-5 report. Additionally (from project memory, not re-verified this audit): websim merge to main, ORCA acknowledgement deletion before 2026-08-23, manual keyboard/screen-reader script, and the public GitHub remote already carrying the raw campsite CSV (data-disclosure posture).

items.name: Open data-coverage limitations
items.detail: Clinton Triangle (160 units) and Multnomah SRV (28) have no locatable address and are absent (~207 people of real capacity); 10 day centres excluded with unpublished capacity though arguably the most relevant daytime clean-air spaces; sex and mobility distributions are 2019-vintage inside a 2026 study; asthma/COPD prevalences imported from Minnesota EHR; three village addresses block/intersection-level; 2019->2025 PIT is not a clean time series.
